quests.title: Pests in the Fields
quests.offer: The farms outside the walls are crawling again. Slimes in the furrows, ants in the grain. Clear them out before the harvest rots, and I'll see you're paid.
quests.hand-in: The farmers will sleep tonight. Here, you've earned this.

quests.title: Stingers
quests.offer: Scorpions have been coming up out of the sand near town and stinging the carters. Kill them, and bring me their stingers - the apothecary pays well for the venom.
quests.hand-in: Good stingers, these. The carters thank you.

quests.title: The Middleland Road
quests.offer: The road into the Middleland isn't safe any more. Orc raiders by day, the dead by night. Go see it for yourself, and thin both out.
quests.hand-in: The caravans can roll again. Well done.

quests.title: Wolves at Moonrise
quests.offer: Werewolves hunt the Middleland when the moon is up, and stalkers follow behind them for the scraps. Bring me three claws so the Council believes me.
quests.hand-in: Three claws, still sharp. The Council can't argue with these.

quests.title: Down the Old Stair
quests.offer: There's a stair under the Middleland that goes down to the second dungeon level. Cyclopes and stone golems hold it now. Go down and break their hold.
quests.hand-in: You came back up. Not everyone does.

quests.title: Troll Blood
quests.offer: Trolls have come down into the hunting grounds. Kill them where they stand, and bring me their blood. Troll blood heals near anything, if you can stand the smell.
quests.hand-in: Phew. That's troll blood all right.

quests.title: The Labyrinth
quests.offer: The Maze swallows hunters whole. Minotaurs walk its halls and beholders watch every turning. Go in, come out, and bring their horns as proof.
quests.hand-in: You found your way out of the Maze. I owe you a drink.

quests.title: Lair of Abaddon
quests.offer: Last hunt, and the worst. Abaddon's lair. Barlogs at the gate, a hellclaw and a tigerworm in the deep. Nobody's asked this of you lightly.
quests.hand-in: You walked into Abaddon's lair and back out. I'll tell this story until I die.

quests.title: Hides for the Tanner
quests.offer: The tanner's out of leather and winter's coming. Amphis hides make the softest boots. Would you fetch me a few?
quests.hand-in: Oh, they're lovely! Here, take some of my honey cakes.

quests.title: Royal Jelly
quests.offer: Giant ants keep a jelly for their queen. A spoonful in tea and the healers swear by it. Bring me three jars' worth?
quests.hand-in: Sweet as anything. The healers will be so pleased.

quests.title: Bone Meal
quests.offer: The town garden needs bone meal, and the skeletons outside town have plenty to spare. It's grim work, I know.
quests.hand-in: Grim, but the roses will love it. Thank you.

quests.title: Frog Song
quests.offer: The big frogs down in the dungeon have glands that make a fine salve for burns. Mind the cyclopes down there.
quests.hand-in: Slippery things! Here - these will serve you better than they serve me.

quests.title: Lizard Scale
quests.offer: In Procella the giant lizards shed scales as hard as steel. The armourers would give anything for a few. Careful - the minotaurs roam there too.
quests.hand-in: Look how they shine! The armourers will be beside themselves.

quests.title: Weeds With Teeth
quests.offer: Procella's cannibal plants bleed a sap that cures fever. They bite, mind you. Gloves won't help.
quests.hand-in: Sticky and smelly and exactly right. You're a treasure.

quests.title: Shells of Druncn
quests.offer: Druncn City's half under water now. Claw turtles and crayfish everywhere. A turtle shell or two would make the finest shields in town.
quests.hand-in: These shells! The smith will make something wonderful.

quests.title: The Nizie Pearl
quests.offer: They say the nizies of Druncn grow a pearl inside them, once in a long while. I've always wanted to see one. Just one.
quests.hand-in: It's beautiful. I'll never forget you brought me this.

quests.title: Restless Graves
quests.offer: The dead outside town won't stay down. Zombies, skeletons - someone is stirring them. Put them back in the ground while I find out who.
quests.hand-in: Quieter already. Here, for your trouble.

quests.title: Clay That Walks
quests.offer: A clay golem walks because a core inside it tells it to. I want to know who wrote those cores. Bring me two.
quests.hand-in: Two cores, and both still warm with the spell. Fascinating.

quests.title: Hellhounds
quests.offer: Hellbounds carry fire from somewhere below. The ash they leave behind is still burning. Collect it for me - carefully.
quests.hand-in: Still smouldering. Something down there feeds them.

quests.title: The Mastermages
quests.offer: The orc mastermages of Procella bind their spells with a sigil. If I could read one, I could unmake them. Take two from their bodies.
quests.hand-in: Crude work, but clever. I'll have them read by morning.

quests.title: The Tower of Hell
quests.offer: The sigils point to the Tower of Hell. Climb it. Dark elves guard the stair and liches the top. Find out what they're guarding.
quests.hand-in: Liches. Of course it was liches. You did well to come back.

quests.title: Ice in the Bones
quests.offer: The liches draw cold from Icebound. Break their source: the ice golems and the frost there. And bring me crystals, so I can see the spell for myself.
quests.hand-in: Cold enough to burn. The liches will feel this.

quests.title: Horns of the Abyss
quests.offer: Demons and gargoyles are coming up through the old dungeons. Demon horn is the one thing that holds a ward against them. Bring me three.
quests.hand-in: Three horns. My wards will hold now.

quests.title: Fires of Infernia
quests.offer: It all ends in Infernia. Walk both halves of it, put down its barlogs, and kill a fire wyvern. Then whoever stirs the dead will have nothing left to stir.
quests.hand-in: It's over. Whatever woke them, it sleeps now. Thank you, truly.
